parameters.query:
SELECT
    co.consultation_id,
    co.customer_id,
    c.customer_name,
    co.reconsultation_at,
    co.store_id,
    co.staff_id,
    cc.privacy_consent,
    cc.recontact_consent,
    'reconsultation'::varchar AS schedule_type
FROM public.consultations co
JOIN public.customers c
    ON co.customer_id = c.customer_id
JOIN public.customer_consents cc
    ON co.customer_id = cc.customer_id
WHERE co.consultation_id = $1
  AND co.reconsultation_at IS NOT NULL
  AND cc.privacy_consent = TRUE
  AND cc.recontact_consent = TRUE
  AND cc.withdrawn_at IS NULL;

parameters.content:
## 재상담 정보 및 동의 조회 노드
privacy_consent
recontact_consent
withdrawn_at (동의 철회 여부 확인)

## 재상담 문자 발송 규칙

D-1이 미래 날짜
→ 오전 10:00

D-1이 오늘인 경우
→ 현재 10:00 이전     → 10:00
→ 10:00 ~ 16:00 이전 → 16:00
→ 16:00 ~ 19:00 이전 → 19:00
→ 19:00 이후          → 스케줄 생성 X

재상담이 오늘 또는 이미 지남
→ 스케줄 생성 X

parameters.query:
INSERT INTO public.message_schedules (
    schedule_id,
    customer_id,
    schedule_type,
    reference_date,
    scheduled_contact_at,
    calendar_event_id,
    schedule_status,
    contact_reason,
    consultation_id,
    schedule_subtype,
    document_id
)
VALUES (
    md5(
        concat_ws(
            '|',
            $1::text,
            $3::text,
            $5::text
        )
    ),
    $2,
    $3,
    $4::date,
    $6::timestamptz,
    NULL,
    'scheduled',
    $7,
    $1,
    $5,
    NULL
)
ON CONFLICT (schedule_id)
DO UPDATE SET
    reference_date = EXCLUDED.reference_date,
    scheduled_contact_at = EXCLUDED.scheduled_contact_at,
    contact_reason = EXCLUDED.contact_reason,
    schedule_status = 'scheduled'
RETURNING
    schedule_id,
    customer_id,
    $8::text AS customer_name,
    schedule_type,
    reference_date,
    scheduled_contact_at,
    calendar_event_id,
    schedule_status,
    contact_reason,
    consultation_id,
    schedule_subtype;

parameters.content:
